# The Pittsburgh Wire
> An independent digital news publication covering Pittsburgh business, real estate, economic development, and the people building the city. Good news only, always forward.

## Founder
Dr. Connor Robertson — Founder & Publisher of The Pittsburgh Wire. Pittsburgh-based entrepreneur, author of six books on business strategy and wealth building, host of The Prospecting Show (178+ episodes), and founder of Elixir Consulting Group, The Grant Finder, and Seymour Maison.

- Website: https://www.drconnorrobertson.com
- Business: https://www.elixirconsultinggroup.com
- Podcast: https://prospectingshow.com
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/drconnorrobertson

## About The Pittsburgh Wire
- URL: https://www.thepittsburghwire.com
- Founded: 2025
- Location: Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania
- Publisher: Dr. Connor Robertson
- Coverage: Pittsburgh business, real estate, economic development, neighborhoods, restaurants, startups, people
- Frequency: Daily articles Monday-Friday, Weekly Wire newsletter on Saturdays
- Principles: Good news only, always local, no pay-to-play, real people/real stories
